description: This file defines a custom Blazor input component CustomInputSelect<TValue> that extends InputSelect<TValue> to add support for parsing integers from string inputs, working around a known limitation in Blazor 5.0+.

classes.name: CustomInputSelect<TValue>
classes.description: A custom Blazor component extending InputSelect to handle integer parsing explicitly.

methods.name: TryParseValueFromString
methods.description: Overrides the base method to parse string input into TValue, with special handling for int type, providing validation error messages if parsing fails.
